card.name: The verb inject and its forms
card.fires_on: Forms of the verb inject (inject, injected, injecting, injectable) and sometimes the noun injection, in drug-label and procedure text describing giving a drug or substance by needle.

modes.description: Inject or injecting used as a step in how to give a drug.
